mechanics.name: Fast Track
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you earn 1 Token, up to 1/2/3. While repairing a Generator, hitting a Great basic Skill Check spends all your Tokens; each Token spent grants that Generator 5% permanent progress.
activation: You must unhook another Survivor to gain a Token.
You must be repairing a Generator and hit a Great basic Skill Check to spend Tokens.
Ends/deactivates when: Tokens are removed when spent on a Great basic repair Skill Check.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.6.0): Changed the trigger to your unhooks, capped the perk at 1/2/3 Tokens, and set progress to 5% per Token (from the prior rework's 1% live value).
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Your unhooks bank tokens that add permanent Generator progress when you hit a Great repair Skill Check.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Gain 1 Token per Survivor you unhook, up to the tier cap of 1/2/3. A Great basic Skill Check while repairing spends all currently held Tokens; each spent Token grants 5% permanent Generator progress.

editorial.summary: Each time you unhook another Survivor, gain one Token up to three; a Great generator Skill Check spends all Tokens for 5% permanent progress each.
useCases: Turn successful rescue participation into permanent generator progress.
Bank multiple Tokens for a single 10–15% objective swing.
Pair with Skill Check support so the conversion is reliable.
counters: You must personally unhook Survivors to earn Tokens.
Requires a Great basic Skill Check to cash out.
Maximum storage is only three Tokens.
pros: Rescue activity naturally occurs in most matches.
Can create a 15% burst from a fully stocked trigger.
cons: Much weaker than its older version for passive token gain.
Competes with rescue perks that help ensure the unhook itself is safe.
Great Skill Check requirement adds execution risk.
analysis: Fast Track sits at this position because the live rework changed its identity from passive teammate-hook scaling into a personal rescue-to-objective converter. Each unhook grants one Token, and a later Great Skill Check turns those Tokens into permanent generator progress.

Fifteen percent permanent progress at three Tokens is a real swing. Permanent progress is especially valuable because regression cannot erase the charges that were removed from the generator's remaining requirement in the same way normal progress can be lost.
The catch is that you must personally generate the rescues and then land the Great Skill Check. A player who is chased often or loses rescue priority may struggle to build Tokens at all.
That lower consistency is why Fast Track no longer sits near its old ranking. The payoff is good, but the modern setup makes it a specialized objective perk instead of a broadly elite one.
editorial.verdict: A respectable rescue-to-generator conversion perk after its rework. Fast Track can create real permanent progress, but only if you personally earn the unhooks and land the Great.
